def f(g):
    out=[]
    for row in g:
        w=len(row)
        zs=[k for k,v in enumerate(row) if v==0]
        cands=[t for t in range(1,w+1) if all(k-t>=0 and row[k-t]!=0 for k in zs)]
        o=row[:]
        if cands: best=max(cands); [o.__setitem__(k,row[k-best]) for k in zs]
        out.append(o)
    return out
